preconditions.description: The number of queries q is between 1 and 500,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= typei <= 2 for typei, _ in queries)
preconditions.description: Each query typei is either 1 or 2.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= vi <= len(vertices) for _, vi in queries)
preconditions.description: Each vertex index vi in the queries is a valid existing vertex index.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(result, float) for result in results)
postconditions.description: Each result for a query of the second type is a real number.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= result <= len(vertices) for result in results)
postconditions.description: Each result for a query of the second type is between 0 and the number of vertices inclusive.

postconditions.expression: all(abs(result - expected) <= 1e-6 for result, expected in zip(results, expected_results))
postconditions.description: Each result for a query of the second type is within 1e-6 of the expected value.
